source.title: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Version 5.0
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, National Institutes of Health, National Cancer Institute
source.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer; read from its text layer on 2026-10-14.

definition: A finding based on laboratory test results that indicate a decrease in number of platelets in a blood specimen.
grade_1: <LLN - 75.0 x 10e9/L; not drawn because the lower limit of normal is laboratory-specific
boundary_convention: CTCAE ranges such as '<50.0 - 25.0' are read as from 25.0 up to but not including 50.0.
difference_from_ctc_v2: Grades 1 and 2 match NCI CTC v2.0 (used by Lonial 2005). Grade 3 is 25 to <50 here versus 10 to <50 in v2.0; grade 4 is <25 here versus <10 in v2.0. A v2.0 grade 4 event is therefore a deeper fall than a v5.0 grade 4 event.
